broker.name: Blueberry Markets
broker.tagline: Its site names VFSC, FSC (Mauritius), and ASIC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: The Blueberry Markets pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard and Direct (also labelled Raw). Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, WebTrader, TradingView, and Blueberry X. The site names these regulators: VFSC, FSC (Mauritius), and ASIC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. A minimum deposit figure on the site is 100 USD. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. VFSC: Blueberry Markets (V) Ltd, Classes A, B and C. FSC (Mauritius): Blueberry Markets (Mauritius) Ltd, GB24203929. ASIC: Blueberry Australia Pty Ltd, 535887.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, global account types and legal-documents index fetched. Legal index names Vanuatu License and Mauritius License documents but does not print licence numbers. Those numbers are in the August 2026 client agreements on blueberrymarkets.com. Mauritius PDF header says FSC Mauritius. Vanuatu PDF header says VFSC Vanuatu and dealer licence classes A, B and C. ASIC AFSL 535887 and ABN 67 646 513 797 are from a search extract of the official Australian FSG PDF, which was not opened as a full fetch. A search extract of the AU account page also says 30:1 retail and 500:1 professional. That split is not on the global account page that was fetched, so it is not used as the advertised maximum. Trading-conditions HTML was geo-blocked for a US IP. Homepage also blocks US retail customers and Malaysian retail customers.
